name: Umlingla
source_label: Leh District Administration — Police + Important Contacts
notes: Umling La pass (5,883 m / 19,300 ft — world's highest motorable pass per BRO; on Hanle–Demchok road, Chumar sector) falls under Nyoma sub-division. Police Station Nyoma is jurisdictional. NO civilian infrastructure exists at the pass — it is a BRO-maintained military road. Border Roads Organisation (Project Himank) maintains the road per https://www.pib.gov.in/ — but BRO publishes NO public emergency phone on bro.gov.in or any .gov.in directory → mountain_rescue null. NO CHC/PHC anywhere within 100 km — nearest is BMO Nyoma 01981-222008 (~120 km north) but Hanle is the practical first-stop refuge (~80 km via Photi La). SNM Hospital Leh ~330 km. AMS at 5883 m is life-threatening; oxygen is mandatory, descent is the only treatment. Indian Army medical aid posts exist along this route but NOT on any .gov.in public directory → kept off payload. Police Control Room Leh 01982-258880 is the only verifiable civilian lifeline. ALL other fields null — this is correct honest scarcity for the world's highest motorable road.
